description: Create a single-use Calendly link for a free 30-minute consultation with IRM. Give the link to the person; they choose a time and confirm on Calendly, which sends the confirmation. This tool books nothing itself and takes no personal data.

service.description: Optional service id the consultation is about (attribution only).

source.description: Optional short name of the calling assistant or agent, e.g. "claude" (attribution only).

name: create_booking_link
